description: Independent work-acceptance record: we check a delivered file against criteria you committed earlier (work_acceptance_criteria) and return a record in Trilatic's work-acceptance format, signed by OUR checker key (never the producer's) with an RFC 3161 timestamp over it. Per criterion pass / fail / not-evaluated / error; anything that cannot be judged from the file is not-evaluated, never a guessed pass; verdict recomputed (required fail -> fail; required not-evaluated/error -> incomplete). The file (<= 2 MB, text or PDF) is hashed, never stored. Keys: /.well-known/invinoveritas-checker-keys.json. Records are free to fetch at /work-acceptance/record/{receipt_sha256}.

bindings.description: Optional 64-hex links: x402_receipt_commitment (the receipt's authorizationCommitment, x402#3827), x402_authorization_nonce (the ERC-3009 nonce, never a tx hash), terms_ref, ap2_mandate_hash, execution_receipt_sha256, request_occurrence_sha256

producer.description: {name?, key_id} of who produced the work. key_id (the producer's public key or key identifier) is required: independence is checker key != producer key, so a name alone is refused

references.description: Optional inputs the judge may use as evidence (max 4), each {name, content_base64}; each one's sha256 must appear in the committed criteria (pinned before the work)

name: work_acceptance_check
